note: The component layer may not contain a colour, radius, shadow or font-size literal — those must be var(--um-*). The px values below are layout mechanics: the size of a drawn shape, an offset, a border width. Anything that could differ from mood to mood is a variable, not a value.

reasons.1: the visually-hidden input that carries a control's checked state
reasons.2: spinner and thumb border width, switch thumb offset, focus ring width
reasons.-2: nudges the tick mark so it sits centred in its box

physicalSides.note: The component layer writes its sides logically, so a right-to-left reader gets the other side. Two rules are allowed to be physical, and both say why.
physicalSides..um-tooltip__arrow: The bubble's arrow points at the trigger, and the placement it belongs to is physical: a bubble placed "left" is placed on the left.
physicalSides..um-popconfirm__arrow: The bubble's arrow points at the trigger, and the placement it belongs to is physical.
